settings.title: Settings
settings.serverIntro: Enter the address of your AREA server. On the Android emulator, use http://10.0.2.2:8080 to reach a server running on your computer.
settings.saveFailed: Could not save the server address on this device.

connection.timeout: The server did not answer in time. Check the address and that your phone is on the same network.
connection.network: Could not reach the server. Check the address and that the server is running.
connection.http: The server answered with an error (HTTP {{status}}).
connection.notArea: This address answered, but it is not an AREA server.

validation.scheme: The address must start with http:// or https://.
validation.host: Enter a valid host name or IP address.
validation.port: The port must be a number between 1 and 65535.
